meta_description: Taylor Plumbing (NE) Ltd, Sunderland. Emergency plumbing, boiler repairs, and installations. Gas Safe registered. Same-day callouts available.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown? We're here within the hour, day or night, across Sunderland and the North East.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs and boiler installations to bathroom renovations and heating system upgrades, we handle every plumbing job.

services.title: Emergency Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry common parts on the van and aim to resolve most jobs first visit.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Repair
services.desc: New boiler fitted with a 10-year warranty, or quick repairs to get your heating back on. Gas Safe certified.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: System upgrades, radiator replacements, and annual servicing to keep your heating efficient and reliable all winter.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Installation
services.desc: Complete bathroom and kitchen plumbing installations, from pipework to taps and appliance connections.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Pipework
services.desc: High-pressure drain cleaning and pipe repairs. We diagnose blockages quickly using CCTV where needed.

services.title: Tap & Valve Repairs
services.desc: Dripping taps, leaking valves, and ballcock replacements. Quick fixes that save water and cut your bills.

about_pullquote: I built this business on one rule: never leave a job half-done.
about_para_1: Taylor Plumbing (NE) Ltd has been serving Sunderland and the surrounding North East for over 18 years. We started with one van and a commitment to honest pricing and swift, reliable work. Today, we've completed over 2,000 plumbing jobs, from emergency callouts at midnight to full heating system overhauls, and we're Gas Safe registered for every gas work we undertake.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we turn up on time, fix the problem right, and give you a straight answer — no unnecessary upsells. Whether it's a frozen pipe in winter or a planned boiler replacement, we treat your home with the same care we'd give our own. That reputation has made us one of the most trusted plumbers in the Sunderland area.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe on a Saturday morning and was in total panic. Called Taylor Plumbing and within 45 minutes Jamie was here. Fixed it properly, explained what went wrong, and the bill was fair. Brilliant service. Would 100% use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Boiler packed in just before Christmas, nightmare timing. But these lads were amazing. Got a new boiler fitted within 2 days, came in on time, and it's working perfectly. Highly recommend. They really know their stuff.
reviews.author: Claire W.

reviews.text: Emergency call at 11pm because of a leak in the bathroom. They answered, came out within an hour, diagnosed the problem, and had it sorted by midnight. Professional, friendly, and no messing about. Will definitely call them again for the central heating service.
reviews.author: David L.
